searchText: I was rereading the ephemeral headers spec and this phrase now confuses me. `The client accepting an Offer MUST neighborhood gossip the headers from index 0 of the content keys list to the accepted anchored header`. Where does neighborhood gossip mean here? Are we talking nodes that are "close" to the OFFERing node since node radius doesn't apply to ephemeral headers? I need to update this since the list is reversed now. Just gossip to N random peers then Oh the definition for `Neighborhood Gossip` just mentions you want to offer to nodes `near`/`interested` it doesn't mention radius, all nodes are interested in the content so I think we are good on that regard
